description:
Control your LG TV, Android TV box or Kodi box with your iPhone, without looking at it.

The whole screen is the remote. Your eyes stay on the TV, and your thumb does the rest.

• Swipe anywhere for the arrows: one swipe = one step, with a tick
• Tap for OK; tap with two fingers or swipe in from the edge for Back
• Hold, then slide for Home, Input, Mute or Settings; lift for Play/Pause
• Hold, then twist your wrist to seek
• A different vibration for each action, so you feel what happened
• Type and speak text into search boxes on the TV
• Touchpad mode: a mouse pointer on the LG TV or on Kodi
• Volume, mute, inputs and power, also for a soundbar through HDMI-CEC
• Interactive tutorial, practice mode and adjustable gestures

Works with:
• LG TVs with webOS. Accept the prompt on the TV once. The iPhone can also turn the TV on (turn on "Turn on via Wi-Fi" in the TV settings).
• Android TV and Google TV boxes, through their built-in remote service. Pair once with the code that the TV shows.
• Kodi, for example CoreELEC or LibreELEC. No pairing.
• A TV and a box together: keys go to the box, input and power go to the TV, and you choose where volume goes. Switch with one gesture.

The app finds the TV and the box on your Wi-Fi, or you type their addresses.

Tested with an LG OLED TV (webOS), a Ugoos AM9 Pro box (Android TV and CoreELEC) and a soundbar on HDMI-CEC.

Free and open source (GPL-3.0). No ads, no account, no data collected. The app talks only to your TV and box on your local network.
keywords: lg tv,webos,android tv,google tv,kodi,coreelec,remote control,gesture,touchpad,eyes free,haptic
promotionalText: One thumb, eyes on the TV: swipe, tap and hold anywhere to control your LG TV, Android TV box or Kodi. Every action has its own vibration.
